name: dissolve-input
title: Dissolve Input
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Input whose text breaks into fading particles when it is submitted or cleared.

meta.descriptionEs: Campo cuyo texto se deshace en partículas al enviarlo o limpiarlo.

examples.title: Campo que se desvanece
examples.description: Campo cuyo texto se deshace en partículas al enviarlo o limpiarlo.

api.name: onDissolve
api.description: Called with the text before it is cleared.

api.name: ...input
api.description: Other props go to the input primitive, except onSubmit.

docs: Particles sample the input's computed text color, so they follow the host theme. Reduced motion clears the field without particles. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
